interest_rates_and_bonds.summary: Global Interest Rate & Bond Scenario: 4 of 6 major central banks (Fed, ECB, BOE, PBOC) are in active rate-cutting cycles. RBI has pivoted its stance to 'NEUTRAL', laying groundwork for rate cuts in late 2024 / early 2025.
